{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute average revenue per order, stratified by customer_segment
# This removes the confounding from segment distribution
stratified_avg_revenue = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['revenue'].mean()

# Compute the average revenue for each channel, but only within each segment
# Then compare channel performance within each segment
channel_revenue_by_segment = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().unstack(level='channel')

# Display the within-segment average revenue comparison
print("Average revenue per order by channel within each customer segment:")
print(channel_revenue_by_segment)

# Compute the difference in average revenue between channels within each segment
# This shows whether email outperforms paid_search within each segment
within_segment_diff = channel_revenue_by_segment['email'] - channel_revenue_by_segment['paid_search']
print("\nDifference (email - paid_search) within each segment:")
print(within_segment_diff)

# Check if email outperforms paid_search in any segment
email_better_in = within_segment_diff[within_segment_diff > 0]
print("\nEmail outperforms paid_search in:")
print(email_better_in)"}
